newsitem.title: CANADA: Air Canada to sell its reservation system.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada to sell its reservation system.

text.p: Air Canada said on Tuesday that it signed a non-binding letter of intent with Galileo International Partnership to sell Galileo Canada, the carrier's wholly-owned computerised reservations systems.
The air carrier did not disclose the financial details of its deal with Galileo International, a partnership of 11 international airlines, including Air Canada.

"The sale of Galileo Canada is consistent with Galileo International's strategy to acquire specific airline-owned national distribution companies," Marc Rosenberg, vice president of sales and product distribution for Air Canada, said in a released statement.

Since its formation three years ago, Galileo Canada has become a leading computerised registration system provider in Canada with over 10,000 terminals in more than 3,000 travel agency locations, Air Canada said.
